name: High Atoll
design_intent:
HIGH ATOLL — THE HIGH WIRE #8 (tier 2, radial rim over a DEEP well). The atoll's radial ring shape re-pitched for the exposure circuit: six platforms wrap in an oval around a central void WELL, but the whole arena hangs ~300px higher over its void so the well and the outer drop are DEEPER (recovery sky ~972px vs atoll's 672) — a longer, scarier recovery from every rim. Kill identity = knock rivals INWARD into the central well or OUTWARD off the rim. kill_shape = void_is_floor. Signature: the circuit's radial layout with the deepest well (atoll is the shallower Meadow-tier original; spires/ridges are linear). Feel = 'fight around the crater high in the sky; the fall into the middle is a long one.'

GEOMETRY (centred on x=0): BL/BR bottom shelves (trampoline, tops y1120) flank the central WELL (gap x-320..320 = 640px, open to the deep void). ML/MR mid shelves (bubblegum, top y600) sit out at the sides, 520px up. TL/TR top perches (spring, top y200) flank the well mouth. Central THRONE (spring, top y-360) hovers 560px above the top perches over the well.

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP ANALYSIS (Tuning.gd: trampoline apex 270 / bubblegum 180 / spring 480; drift ~395 trampoline / ~320 bubblegum / ~527 spring MAX; normal_boost_max 760 crosses 640px in ~0.9s @ ~24 fuel; super 2800 clears all). Traversal WRAPS around the ring:
- BOTTOM crossing BL<->BR over the WELL: 640px of open void (well mouth). > 527. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; miss = fall INTO the deep well. Verb: FLY. (Rule A.)
- LEFT/RIGHT climb BL->ML (and BR->MR): 520px vertical climb (trampoline apex 270 reaches only 250px short). JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED. Verb: FLY. (Rule B.)
- ML->TL (and MR->TR): 300px horizontal AND 400px up (diagonal ~500px); bubblegum apex 180 covers neither. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- TOP crossing TL<->TR over the WELL: 640px over the well mouth. > 527. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; miss = fall down the central column. Verb: FLY. (Rule A.)
- CLIMB to the CENTRAL THRONE (top y-360): 560px above the top perches; spring apex 480 falls 80px short over the open well. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED. Verb: FLY (+ SUPER). (Rule B.)
- RECOVER: base shelf bottom 1248 -> bottom blast line 2220 = 972px of recovery sky (up to 2532px under the throne, a very deep well) -> a fuelled knock boosts back out of the well mouth; the ML/MR shelves sit ~600px inside the side blast (a fast outer-rim ring-out). Verb: FLY.
- No bounce route exists around the ring or up to the throne, so the jetpack is required to move at all. Vertical AND horizontal distance are load-bearing, not scenery.
